KARNATAKA VETERINARY, ANIMAL AND FISHERIES SCIENCES UNIVERSITY
P.B. No. 6, Nandinagar, BIDAR – 585 226, Karnataka, India
INFORMATION BULLETIN
FOR
POSTGRADUATE DEGREE PROGRAMME - 2025-26
“The applicants shall read this Information Bulletin before filling
up the application form and exercise as many as options possible
in order to become eligible for all seats, because in subsequent
rounds additional options cannot be executed”. The seats are
likely to change in final seat matrix. University reserves rights to

are advised to visit kvafsu.edu.in web site daily at least twice until
counseling is over. No postal correspondence will be sent.
INTRODUCTION
Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University, Bidar was
established as per the Karnataka Act No. 9 of 2004 called “The Karnataka Veterinary, Animal
and Fisheries University Act 2004” and published in the Karnataka Gazette Extra-Ordinary
on the 23rd day of February, 2004. The University is established exclusively for providing
education, conduct of research and extension in the areas of Veterinary, Animal, Dairy and
Fisheries Sciences in the state of Karnataka. The logo of the University is inscribed with the
slogan “Farmers Friendly and Rural Oriented”, which emphasizes the importance given to
betterment of farming community.
KVAFSU is an autonomous academic institution governed by its Board of
Management which regulates the policies of the university in accordance with the provision
of act and statutes. The University administration also has the support of the Finance
Committee. Academic matters are looked after by the Board of Studies and the Academic
Council while Research Council and Extension Education Council decide the research and
extension activities of the University, respectively.
The University offers Postgraduate and Doctoral Degree programs in Veterinary and
Animal Sciences at four constituent Veterinary Colleges at Bidar, Bengaluru, Shivamogga,
and Hassan The Gadag College has started PG Programme in the year2025-26, while Dairy
and Fisheries Sciences are being offered at Dairy Science College, Bengaluru and College of
Fisheries, Mangaluru, respectively.

1.0 Post-Graduate Facilities at Different Campuses:
I. VETERINARY COLLEGE, BENGALURU
The Veterinary College, Bengaluru earlier known as Mysuru Veterinary College, was started
in the year 1958 and was affiliated to University of Mysuru. In 1964, it became a constituent college
of University of Agricultural Sciences, Bengaluru and subsequently, it became part of KVAFSU in
April, 2005. The college is offering Masters’ and Doctoral Degree Programme in various subjects
since 1966.
II. VETERINARY COLLEGE, BIDAR
The College was established in 1984 under University of Agricultural Sciences Bengaluru
and later became a constituent college of University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad during 1986
and subsequent a constituent college of KVASFU in April 2005. The College is offering Masters’ and
Doctoral degree programmes in selected subjects from academic year 1995-96.

I. INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HEALTH AND VETERINARY BIOLOGICALS, BENGALURU

MASTERS’ DEGREE PROGRAMME
Eligibility Criteria for admission to Masters’ degree programme as per ICAR:
a. Masters’ Degree Programme
i. A Bachelor's degree in Veterinary / Dairy / Fisheries science from any Institute /
university accredited by VCI, / ICAR New Delhi
ii. OGPA of 6.00/10.00 or equivalent OGPA / equivalent percentage of marks for general
category and 5.50/10.00 or equivalent OGPA / equivalent percentage of marks for SC(A) /
SC(B) / SC(C) / ST / Cat-I candidates at Bachelor’s degree level for Veterinary and Animal
Sciences.
iii. OGPA of 6.50/10.00 or equivalent OGPA / equivalent percentage of marks for general
category and 6.00/10.00 or equivalent OGPA / equivalent percentage of marks for SC(A) /
SC(B) / SC(C) / ST / Cat-I candidates at Bachelor’s degree level for Dairy and Fisheries
Sciences.
iv. Candidate for master degree programme should be a citizen of India and must have studied
in any educational institution(s) in Karnataka State for a period not less than seven academic
years at any time up to the Bachelor degree as on 18.01.2026 of the admission year. [Not
applicable to candidates belonging to GOK/GOI/ICAR nominees, NRIs and Foreign
Nationals (FN)]. However, in the event of candidates not available in a particular subject
then the domicile requirement of seven years could be relaxed to outside state candidates in
respect of admission to masters’ degree programme of the University only. After third round
of allotment, after exhaustion of Karnataka candidates, out of state candidates will be
considered, only in walk in admission process.
The domicile requirement is not applicable for admission to doctoral degree programme.
v. Candidate must have appeared for All India Entrance Examination for Admission to
Masters’ degree Programme (AIEEA-PG) conducted by NTA-ICAR New Delhi for the
academic year 2025-26 and should produce Score Card and Rank Card in the specified
subject at time of submission of application.
Exceptions for domicile criteria:
The criteria prescribed above shall not apply in case of candidates who fulfill any one of the
following, provided appropriate Document of proof are furnished in support of their claim. In what
follows, children mean only ‘natural born’ children and adopted ones as per the norms and
regulations followed for adopting the child.
i. Children of Defense personnel, Central Government employees/Statutory Corporation set
up, owned or controlled by the Central / Karnataka State Government serving on duty in the
State or both as on the last date of submission of the application. At least 12 months
immediately before such date.
ii. Children of State Government employees including children of Members of the All-India
Services born in the Karnataka State Cadre who:
a. are serving or have served outside the state of Karnataka on deputation during the
relevant period.
b. are in the service of the state as on the last date of the application or retired from the
service prior to as on the date of submission of the application.
iii. Children of working or retired employees of Central or State Government or Joint
undertaking where employees:
a. had declared to the Central Government any place in Karnataka State to be his/her
home town.
b. had either studied in any educational institution in the State of Karnataka run or
recognized by the Government of Karnataka for not less then seven years at any time
prior to the last date fixed for notified for submission of application or has passed
Bachelor degree in Karnataka.
iv. Children of serving Defense personnel or Ex-servicemen whose home address at the time of
joining the Defense service was in Karnataka. Proof of such domicile should be produced
either by obtaining the extract from the record office of the defense units or a Certificate from
the Rajya / District Sainik Board.
B. DOCTORAL (Ph.D.) DEGREE PROGRAMME
i. Masters’ degree in respective or allied subject from any Institute / University accredited by
ICAR, New Delhi.
ii. OGPA of 7.00/10.00 or equivalent OGPA / equivalent percentage of marks for general category
and 6.50/10.00 or equivalent OGPA / equivalent percentage of marks for SC-A/SC-B/SC-C/
ST/Category-I candidates at Masters’ degree level.
iii. The allied subjects for admission to Doctoral degree programme in various disciplines of
Veterinary, Animal, Dairy and Fisheries Sciences as notified by the University from time to
time.
iv. Candidate must have appeared for All India Competitive Examination for Admission to
Doctoral Degree programme (AICEA-PhD) conducted by NTA-ICAR, New Delhi in the
academic year 2025-26 and must produce Score Card and Rank Card in the specified subject at
the time of admission
2.0 Mode of selection for Masters’ and Doctoral degree programme:
The selection of candidates shall be done on the basis of rank scored by the candidate in All
India Entrance Examination for Admission to Masters’ degree Programme (AIEEA-PG) and All
India Competitive Examination for Admission to Doctoral Degree programme (AICEA-PhD)
conducted by NTA-ICAR, New Delhi for the academic year 2025-26. No separate PG entrance
examination shall be conducted by KVAFSU, Bidar unless otherwise notified.
3.0 Minimum duration for Masters’ / Doctoral Degree Programme:
A minimum of two academic years / four semesters shall ordinarily be required for
completion of course work, research, thesis preparation and examinations leading to the award of
the Master degree. In case of Doctoral degree, a minimum period of three academic years / six
semesters is ordinarily required for completion.
4.0 Maximum duration for completion of Master /Doctoral Degree programme
The students admitted to Masters’ are given a maximum time limit of 10 Semesters
consecutively from the date of registration to complete all the requirements for the award of the
Masters’ degree.
The students admitted to Doctoral programme are given a maximum time limit of 14
Semesters consecutively from the date of registration to complete all the requirements for the
award of the Doctoral degree.
There is no provision for re-admission. Only fresh admissions are allowed.
5.0 Reservation of seats
Reservation of seats for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes and
other categories shall be ensured as per the Orders / guidelines communicated by the Government
of Karnataka from time to time.
5.1 Seat allotment and conversion of vacant seats: Candidates must excise all the possible options
in first round only. Subsequent round addition of seats is not permitted.
(a) Based on the merit and priority of options exercised by the candidates the first round of
allotment begins; The computer programme will allot the seats and while allotting the seats
in the first Round at any stage the seat allotted if any, will automatically get cancelled upon
allotment of a seat in the subsequent discipline and such cancelled seat will be considered for
allotment of a seat in the next iteration. Therefore, multiple iterations may take place in the
first Round. The computer programme will stop the allotment only if the last seat is allotted
or when it reaches the last rank in each discipline whichever is earlier. That means the
candidates will always be climbing upwards both in options and in roster. The order of
allotment will be repeated in first round until there is no change in the allotment of any
candidate.
